description: This source file implements core socket processing functions (receiving and sending data) for the Ansc Broker Engine TCP object, including handling of socket errors, connection closures, and data transfer notifications.

classes.name: PANSC_BROKER_ENGINE_TCP_OBJECT
classes.description: Represents the TCP engine object responsible for handling socket communication within the broker system.

classes.name: PANSC_BROKER_SERVER_TCP_OBJECT
classes.description: Represents the server object managing TCP socket connections and modes.

classes.name: PANSC_BROKER_SOCKET_TCP_OBJECT
classes.description: Represents individual TCP socket objects, managing individual connection states and data buffers.

classes.name: PANSC_BSTO_WORKER_OBJECT
classes.description: Represents the worker object responsible for processing socket events and notifications.

classes.name: PANSC_BETO_PACKET_OBJECT
classes.description: Represents data packets queued for asynchronous sending.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscBetoRecv(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket)
methods.description: Receives data from a socket, handles socket errors, connection closures, and notifies the owner about received data or errors.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscBetoSend(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize,ANSC_HANDLE hReserved)
methods.description: Sends data over a socket, supporting asynchronous and synchronous modes, handling errors, and updating socket statistics.
